lunarPhases.omitted: all non-decennial calendar years from 1900 through 2100 and every calendar year from 2101 through 2130
lunarPhases.omissionBasis: the pinned lunar table contains only one year per decade and ends at 2100; this plan retains every archived year in the approved interval

seasons.omissionBasis: the pinned season table ends at 2100; this plan retains every archived season in the approved interval

measurementChronology.initialObservation: the local plan was written before the first runner execution, but the plan and assessment first entered repository history together; repository history does not independently prove the original premeasurement chronology
measurementChronology.prospectiveReplay: this revision freezes the same retained rows, identities, threshold, and omissions for a new replay after the initial results had already been observed; it is not a blind first measurement

lunarPhases.acquisitionRecipe: generate/moonphase/maketest.bat downloaded one response for every tenth year from 1800 through 2100 and generate/moonphase/parse_moon_phases.js transformed those files at the pinned Astronomy Engine revision
lunarPhases.timeScaleTreatment: calendar fields are treated as UT coordinates and converted to TT with Astronomy_DeltaT_EspenakMeeus

seasons.acquisitionRecipe: generate/seasons/maketest.bat downloaded one response for every year from 1800 through 2100 and generate/seasons/parse_seasons.js transformed those files at the pinned Astronomy Engine revision
seasons.timeScaleTreatment: calendar fields are treated as UT coordinates and converted to TT with Astronomy_DeltaT_EspenakMeeus
